authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local Planning Authority dataset contains the administrative boundary for each LPA in England and reports 337 LPAs; up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. Planning Data documentation confirms LPA entities can provide exact entity IDs/geometries for spatial queries. However the fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA identifier/name, LAD identifier/name, local-plan/local-plan-boundary reference, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any one of the 337 LPA polygons would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
